description: Union trades operating engineers sequence in the crane and lift simulator: walk the pre-op inspection, read the lift plan against the load chart, set the lift zone with a posted signal person, run the pick on standard hand signals only, then park, shut down, log and debrief. Mirrors the simulator-room training model used at flagship operating-engineer training centres (IUOE ITEC — alignment from the 2026-11-10 industry pass, not a partnership). Simulation only — not a crane operator certification, not a licence, not an apprenticeship credential.

halls.note: No hall mapped. Hall mapping is open (Phase 4). The 111-hall roster in the SmartCiti.X bundle is an in-repo list; 0 of 111 signed off by a named practitioner — a named hall is not a partner.

objectives: Walk a full pre-op inspection and report defects instead of working around them
Check a planned pick against the load chart at the working radius
Set a barricaded lift zone with a posted signal person
Run a pick on standard hand signals — and stop on any unclear signal
Park, shut down, log the lift and debrief

sites.indiana: Proposed/planned training site — no site, city, or address named.
sites.louisiana: Proposed/planned training site — no site, city, or address named.

sources: OSHA Cranes & Derricks in Construction standard, 29 CFR 1926 Subpart CC (osha.gov/cranes-derricks-construction): inspections, load charts, signal persons, and the stop rule on unclear signals.
OSHA hand signals for crane operations (standard signal chart referenced in 1926.1422).
Industry pass 1 (2026-11-10): IUOE ITEC flagship centre teaches with simulator rooms — alignment reference only.

stations.title: Inspection apron — crane, rigging board, pre-op checklist
Simulator cab — controls, load chart display, lift plan
Lift zone — load, tag lines, signal spotter position

steps.action: Pre-op inspection: walk the checklist — structure, wire rope, hook block, and the rigging gear on the board.
steps.check: Checklist complete; defects reported, not worked around.

steps.action: Read the lift plan and the load chart: confirm the load weight, the working radius, and the chart capacity before any pick.
steps.check: Load within chart capacity at the planned radius.

steps.action: Set up the pick: stabilisers set, lift zone barricaded, signal person posted where the operator can see them.
steps.check: Zone barricaded; signal person in place.

steps.action: Run the pick on standard hand signals only. Any signal you cannot read clearly means stop — every time.
steps.check: Pick landed on the mark; stop rule honoured.

steps.action: Park and shut down the machine, log the lift, and debrief with the coach.
steps.check: Machine secured; log complete; debrief done.
